title: BWI Marshall Airport Facts and Figures
publisher: BWI Marshall Airport / Maryland Aviation Administration
relevance: Official BWI source for operator and acreage; states BWI is operated by the Maryland Aviation Administration and is 3,596.3 acres.
notes: Best concise official airport-identity source for a bounded BWI campus.

title: Rental Cars
publisher: BWI Marshall Airport / Maryland Aviation Administration
relevance: Official BWI source locating the consolidated rental-car facility at Stoney Run Road and New Ridge Road and describing it as part of the airport's rental-car operation.
notes: Useful for showing the BWI facility system is not equivalent to a single municipal place boundary.

title: Final Environmental Assessment and Section 4(f) Determination, ALP Phase I Improvements at BWI Marshall Airport, Appendix H: Biological Resources
relevance: Official MAA appendix stating MAA owns and maintains approximately 3,500 acres of contiguous BWI property associated with airside operations, landside facilities, parking areas, maintenance buildings, and a consolidated rental car facility, plus approximately 400 acres of offsite properties.
notes: Strongest official textual source for using the contiguous BWI property footprint while excluding generic offsite holdings.

title: Final Environmental Assessment and Section 4(f) Determination and Finding of No Significant Impact / Record of Decision, ALP Phase I Improvements at BWI Marshall Airport
relevance: Official MAA environmental-review PDF whose figures repeatedly label the Airport Property Boundary or BWI Airport Property Boundary.
notes: Primary official map-style evidence that BWI has a defined property boundary for planning and review.

title: COMAR 11.03.01.01 Definitions
relevance: Defines Air operations area, Airport, Airport police, On-Airport, and Terminal in BWI-specific facility terms.
notes: Core legal source for the ordinary BWI facility footprint.

title: MDTA Police BWI Thurgood Marshall Airport Travel Tips
relevance: Official MDTA statement that MDTA Police provide law-enforcement services at BWI and traffic management at the terminal.
notes: Best concise public source that MDTA is the current provider of the BWI police function.

title: MDTA Police Contact Us
relevance: Lists Baltimore/Washington International Thurgood Marshall Airport as a distinct MDTA Police command with its own commander.
notes: Shows BWI is operationally treated as its own airport detachment, not as generic county/place geography.

title: 2025 Financial Statements and Supplemental Exhibits
relevance: Official audited statement that MDTA Police provide law-enforcement services to MAA at BWI with protection in the main terminal, surrounding roadways, parking garages and lots, and the rental-car and cargo facilities.
notes: Best operational-scope source for what the BWI police footprint actually covers.

title: Transportation Article Section 4-208
relevance: Primary statute placing MDTA police authority on MAA property, requiring MDTA Police to provide police services to MAA, preserving continuity from the former MAA police force, and authorizing a conditional 500-foot perimeter-security extension.
notes: Key source for the MDTA versus MAA role distinction and for rejecting a default perimeter buffer.

title: Criminal Procedure Article Section 2-102
relevance: Recognizes the MDTA chief-of-police notice role on property owned, leased, operated by, or under the control of MAA, MDTA, or MPA.
notes: Useful corroboration that MAA property is treated as part of the MDTA police jurisdictional sphere.
